STRICT ART DIRECTION: authentic 16-bit console JRPG sprite, SNES-era carefully hand-placed pixel art at a LOW native logical resolution, bold readable clusters, visibly large square pixels, controlled 20-24 color palette, 3-4 shades per material, selective dark 1-pixel outline. NOT high-resolution illustration, NOT a smooth painting with noise, NOT anime key art, NOT low-poly or SVG. Simplify microscopic embroidery into a few iconic pixel clusters. Adult fantasy proportions, no oversized chibi head. Print the finished low-res sprite enlarged with nearest-neighbor sharp square blocks, consistent 8-16x enlargement; no smoothing, antialiasing, gradients, text or watermark. ONE full-body sprite centered in an otherwise genuinely transparent square canvas, entire head/feet/weapon tips inside frame with 7 percent clear margin. Strong three-quarter silhouette facing LEFT. Correct limbs, coherent joint connections, plausible hands and weapon grips. No background, scenery, floor plane, colored haze or giant magical aura. DIRECTION IS MANDATORY: FACE AND ATTACK TOWARD THE LEFT EDGE OF THE IMAGE; this enemy stands to the RIGHT of the player in battle. Head, gaze, muzzle, weapon tip and attack gesture point LEFT; body in left-facing three-quarter or side view, never right-facing. BOSS sprite native logical size approximately 96x96 pixels, impressive but still bold 16-bit clusters. Name and identity: Core Warden / ผู้พิทักษ์แกนโลก. BOSS CORE WARDEN: massive primordial magma guardian, broad humanoid body formed from cooled lava armor, open molten geode chest, two enormous stone fists and two pillar-like legs, glowing basalt horn ridge, thick chains embedded in shoulders. Huge elemental mass, no robot face. Existing moves that the design must fit: Warden's Lava Torrent (fire); Core-Forged Fist (phys); Eternal Flame Curse (fire). Original standalone monster design, frightening and cool, no humans standing nearby, no palette-swapped duplicate from another creature. Entire body and every tail, wing, weapon tip visible within transparent canvas. Facing LEFT is required.
